content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from boss_homesSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inAudio is mutedboss_homes•FollowMore optionsboss_homes 23wJustin Bieber once rented a striking modern mansion in Beverly Hills, famously known as the “Glass House” or “Salad Spinner House,” valued at around $35 million. Designed by architect Ed Niles in 2009, the home features dramatic glass-and-steel architecture wrapped around a circular courtyard, with nearly invisible glass walls offering panoramic views. Spanning approximately 7,500 square feet, the six-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom estate includes luxury amenities such as an infinity pool, a seven-car garage, and a sleek, minimalist interior.
